# Sharp Sighted Photos

> Portrait and personal-branding photography in North Texas (the DFW "121 corridor"): executive and corporate headshots, team photography, and lifestyle/story portraits for founders, executives, creators, and professional firms.

Sharp Sighted Photos is the portrait branch of Sharp Sighted Studio (founded 2022 by Dean Draper). On-location across the DFW 121 corridor — we come to you.

- Phone: (214) 233-5338
- Email: dean@sharpsightedstudio.com
- Service area: Allen, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Southlake, Grapevine, Denton, and the wider DFW 121 corridor

## What we do
- Corporate & executive headshots — clean, consistent, on-location team photography for law, finance, agency, and other professional firms.
- Lifestyle & story portraits — personal-branding sessions for founders, executives, creators, and remarkable people whose story doesn't fit a generic studio backdrop.
- Print & product collections — fine-art prints and heirloom books.

## The brand
One branch of Sharp Sighted Studio (https://sharpsightedstudio.com), alongside Sharp Sighted Media (real estate media) and Sharp Sighted Studio (creative community and education). Tagline: Stay Sharp. Stay Seen. Stay Human.
